verdict: clear: shared natural-title total order/cache and phone identity viewport/input lifecycle reviewed
review_notes: Natural keys use NFKC, ROOT case folding and bounded Chinese ordinal contexts only for 第…季/部/集. Original titles/models are never rewritten; S-style names sort naturally within their own spelling, with no cross-spelling season equivalence or pinyin promise.

Digit runs compare effective decimal length and lexicographic digits without integer parsing; equal values continue through suffixes. Fixed identity then original-title ties retain source-specific records. Independent primary-key and Video comparisons passed antisymmetry, transitivity and equality-substitution properties over159272 triples.

Keys are precomputed once per row per sort; no shared mutable Collator exists. Sorted snapshots are immutable and cached, invalidated only by actual new accepted rows. Independent cache tests verify old snapshots, late earlier-season insertion, failure/empty-page reuse and unchanged page retry/cursor progression.

Removing only the snapshot ordering/cache/dirty additions restores the complete prior AllCatalogSearch text; worker/request/cursor/cancel code remains unchanged. Shared phone/TV helper bodies are identical after package normalization.

Phone captures the actual DOWN-bound Holder.video, rejects canceled/dragged/stale-ticket taps and opens only objects still present in the current list. Ordinary browsing duplicate IDs remain clickable; unique identity is required for anchors, not for ordinary bound clicks.

Touch/settling/scroll, hidden detail, background and unfocused-window updates are deferred. Current provider+API+video identity plus row offset restores the viewport; cached-list-only progress does not notify/reorder cards.

Window loss cancels input across touch and non-touch paths, removes pending drain and clears stale scroll state. Focus gain does not revive an old click; new valid DOWN/key or explicit card accessibility CLICK restores input while retaining the native item accessibility delegate.

Only two prior phone Java files plus the new title helper differ;32 other Java files, player/API/provider configuration and the143 poster geometry/category presentation are retained. Host/source checks do not establish device click/focus/pixel-offset acceptance.
